title: Omar's toy
offscreen: Take turns with a kitchen timer: when it rings, you pass the toy on.

scenes.text: Omar has the toy you wanted.

options.label: I ask if I can play with it after
options.outcome: Omar says: I'll pass it to you in a bit. Meanwhile you play with the blocks.

options.label: I take it
options.outcome: Omar gets angry and cries. The teacher comes. Nobody plays any more.

options.label: I ask to play together
options.outcome: Omar thinks about it and says yes. You play together.

scenes.text: Two children are playing and you'd like to join in.

options.label: I ask: can I play?
options.outcome: They say yes! They let you be the dog.

options.label: I watch from close by for a bit
options.outcome: After a while they ask if you want to play.

options.label: I go somewhere else
options.outcome: That's fine too. Maybe tomorrow you'll ask.

intro.bo: Shall we try together, {nome}? If we get it wrong, we'll try again.
intro.pilu: Look carefully, {nome}. Then tell me what you think.
intro.tango: Come on, {nome}, let's do it! Slowly though... all right, slowly.

outro.bo: We did it, {nome}. I got a bit scared, but it worked out.
outro.pilu: Well done, {nome}, you looked carefully. That's enough for today.
outro.tango: Done! {nome}, tomorrow we'll do another one. Now I'm off running.
